{{Quote|Pina had not killed me, though many times I have wished he had. I do not know who constructed my tomb or set me within it.|Arden Lyn|<ref name="EGTW" />}}
At some point following the [[Duel on Irkalla]], a '''tomb''' for [[Arden Lyn]] was constructed on [[Irkalla]] by an an unidentified party.<ref name="EGTW" /> Entombed with her was the [[Kashi Mer talisman]].<ref name="tep">{{GamerCite|5|The Emperor's Pawns}}</ref> Lyn's body was suspended in a stasis field, only to reawaken some [[4 BBY/Legends|24,000 years]] later during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="EGTW" />
